attacks.target: d2, r6, b-ex7, b-ex8, r14, b17
attacks.claim: d2 starts the two-month period from the notification of any refusal of the grievance, but cpca 830 ¶4 starts it from the refusal only when the administration answered within the two months it is given (خلال الأجل الممنوح لها). When the administration stayed silent for two months, ¶2 and ¶3 make the silence a refusal and the two months run from the end of the silence; a late explicit refusal does not restart them. Example r6 shows the error: decision notified 2025-06-01, so the grievance was lodged by early October 2025 at the latest, the silence ended by early December 2025 and the period closed by early February 2026, yet a refusal notified 2026-05-04 makes d2 report 'none' for a petition of 2026-06-01, which is out of time.
attacks.verifierQuote: في حالة رد الجهة الإدارية خلال الأجل الممنوح لها، يبدأ سريان أجل شهرين (2) من تاريخ تبليغ الرفض. / وفي حالة سكوت الجهة الإدارية، يستفيد المتظلم من أجل شهرين (2)، لتقديم طعنه القضائي، الذي يسري من تاريخ انتهاء أجل الشهرين (2) المشار إليه في الفقرة أعلاه. / يجوز للشخص المعني بالقرار الإداري، تقديم تظلم إلى الجهة الإدارية مصدرة القرار في الأجل المنصوص عليه في المادة 829 أعلاه.
attacks.change: Three proposed slots: administrative_grievance_in_time, administrative_grievance_answered_in_time, administrative_grievance_date. d1 now runs unless a grievance was lodged in time (830 ¶1); d2 runs only when the refusal was notified within the two months (830 ¶4); new deadline d5 (interpretive, warn) counts four months from the grievance's notification after silence or a late answer (830 ¶2, ¶3). Open point o10 rewritten. r6 corrected (it now asks the grievance date, d2 none), b-ex7, b-ex8, r14 given the in-time facts; a-ex17's questions updated; verifier example v-adv1 (r6's case with the grievance date: d5 warns).

attacks.target: x4, specialised_commercial_courts_installed, b-ex10, r7, o1, b32, b33
attacks.claim: The record treats a specialised commercial court that is 'not installed' for the area as sending the dispute back to the commercial section (x4 gives no exit when the slot is no). Executive decree 26-133 of 30 March 2026, amending decree 23-53, raises the specialised commercial courts to 25, installs the new ones progressively, and extends the territorial jurisdiction of the courts installed before it over the area of each new court until that court is installed. Since the 12 courts of decree 23-53 cover the whole territory, there is no area left to the commercial section for the matters of 536 مكرر: the answer 'not installed' sends the lawyer to a section that lacks subject-matter jurisdiction (531 ¶1, 36 ¶1).
attacks.verifierQuote: المادة 2 مكرر 1 : يمتد الاختصاص الإقليمي للمحاكم التجارية المتخصصة المنصبة قبل صدور هذا المرسوم، إلى دائرة الاختصاص الإقليمي للمحاكم التجارية المتخصصة الجديدة إلى حين تنصيب هذه الأخيرة.
attacks.quoteRef: Executive decree 26-133, Official Journal 2026 no. 27 (12 April 2026), p. 10, file sha256 099f3ad407e7b85a7546b1d29f0e274c45df08d253076c80965c3f68abaf0c0c
attacks.change: x4 no longer turns on installation: it warns whenever specialised_commercial_matter is one of the six matters; the proposed slot specialised_commercial_courts_installed is removed (no item read it any more) and dropped from the examples; b-ex10 and r7 now expect warn; message and interpretiveNote name the extension of installed courts. Open point o11 (grade D, decree not in the store); requests appended for decrees 23-53 and 26-133. Example v-adv2.

attacks.claim: t2 says only that the code's territorial rules apply to the specialised commercial court, and k14/k42 record the seats and areas as not found. The areas are fixed by executive decree 23-53, now replaced in its annex by decree 26-133: each of the 25 courts covers named judicial councils (for example Sétif covers Sétif, M'sila and Bordj Bou Arreridj; Boumerdès covers Boumerdès, Bouira and Tizi Ouzou). The code's rule (defendant's domicile, art. 37) only picks the council; the court is the specialised commercial court whose annex area contains that council, which is usually not in the same wilaya.
attacks.verifierQuote: يحدد عدد المحاكم التجارية المتخصصة بخمس وعشرين (25) محكمة عبر كامل التراب الوطني، تحدد دوائر اختصاصها الإقليمي طبقا للملحق المرفق بهذا المرسوم.
attacks.quoteRef: Executive decree 26-133, Official Journal 2026 no. 27 (12 April 2026), p. 10, file sha256 099f3ad407e7b85a7546b1d29f0e274c45df08d253076c80965c3f68abaf0c0c (art. 2, replacing art. 2 of decree 23-53; annex pp. 10-11)
attacks.change: t2's rule now says the areas are fixed by executive decree as groups of judicial councils and asks the lawyer to find the court whose area contains the council; k14 and k42 notes name the decrees (still searchedNotFound in the store) and open point o11 (grade D); requests appended. Example v-adv3.

attacks.claim: The record cites the Code of Criminal Procedure by the articles of Ordinance 66-155 (arts. 2, 3, 4, 5, 10) and grades o3 'D, from memory' because the code is not in the store. Ordinance 66-155 was repealed by law 25-14 of 3 August 2025, the new Code of Criminal Procedure, published in the Official Journal of 13 August 2025. The civil-action rules are now arts. 3 to 7 of law 25-14 and the limitation of the civil action is art. 17 (civil code rules, but no filing before the criminal court once the public action is time-barred).
attacks.verifierQuote: المادة 889 : يلغى الأمر رقم 66-155 المؤرخ في 18 صفر عام 1386 الموافق 8 يونيو سنة 1966 والمتضمن قانون الإجراءات الجزائية، المعدل والمتمم. / المادة 4 : يجوز مباشرة الدعوى المدنية مع الدعوى العمومية في وقت واحد أمام الجهة القضائية الجزائية. / المادة 17 : ... تتقادم الدعوى المدنية وفق أحكام القانون المدني. غير أنه لا يجوز رفع هذه الدعوى أمام الجهة القضائية الجزائية بعد انقضاء أجل تقادم الدعوى العمومية.
attacks.quoteRef: Law 25-14 (Code of Criminal Procedure), Official Journal 2025 no. 54 (13 August 2025), file sha256 50e9671fe8d4377c616af3f6652126796b62eee49eb67397427b775abd7deb73, art. 889 p. 108, art. 4 p. 8, art. 17 p. 9
attacks.change: Checklist k16, k17, k18, k20, k44, k45 notes now name law 25-14 and its articles (still searchedNotFound: not in the store); o3's why and readings rest on the Official Journal text instead of memory, grade D kept until the store reads it twice; x6's interpretiveNote names law 25-14; request appended. Example v-adv4.

attacks.claim: The record says no general rule stays the civil claim while a criminal case runs (k45: only the handwriting stay of cpca 165 ¶4 was found) and x6 only warns about civil-code 339. Law 25-14 art. 5 ¶2 obliges the civil court to defer judgment on a civil action for damage from an offence until the public action, once set in motion, is finally decided. Art. 6 makes the choice of the civil route binding, unless the prosecution starts before the civil court rules on the merits, in which case the victim must withdraw the civil claim. Art. 7 keeps the urgent-matters judge competent for provisional measures.
attacks.verifierQuote: المادة 5 : يجوز أيضا مباشرة الدعوى المدنية منفصلة عن الدعوى العمومية. غير أنه يتعين أن ترجئ الجهة القضائية المدنية الحكم في الدعوى المرفوعة أمامها لحين الفصل نهائيا في الدعوى العمومية إذا كانت قد حركت. / المادة 6 : ... إلا أنه يجوز ذلك إذا كانت النيابة العامة قد باشرت الدعوى العمومية قبل أن يصدر من الجهة القضائية المدنية حكم في الموضوع، ويتعين على المدعي المدني، في هذه الحالة، التنازل عن دعواه المدنية المرفوعة أمام الجهة القضائية المدنية.
attacks.quoteRef: Law 25-14 (Code of Criminal Procedure), Official Journal 2025 no. 54 (13 August 2025), file sha256 50e9671fe8d4377c616af3f6652126796b62eee49eb67397427b775abd7deb73, arts. 5 and 6, p. 8
attacks.change: x6's message now states the deferral of the civil judgment and the binding choice of route; interpretiveNote and o3 updated (grade D, not in the store); k17 and k45 notes name art. 5 ¶2. Example v-adv5.

attacks.claim: t3 always sends the request for an order to pay to the president of the court of the debtor's domicile. For a debt in one of the matters of the specialised commercial court (for example a bank's claim against a merchant), art. 536 مكرر 6 ¶1 gives the president of the specialised commercial court every power of the president of the ordinary court in commercial disputes, which includes the order to pay of art. 306. Its ¶2 also gives urgent and protective measures in these matters to a section president of the specialised court, which n5 does not mention.
attacks.verifierQuote: يمارس رئيس المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة كل الصلاحيات الموكلة لرئيس المحكمة العادية في المنازعات التجارية. / يمكن رئيس قسم بالمحكمة التجارية المتخصصة أن يتخذ، عن طريق الاستعجال، الإجراءات المؤقتة أو التحفظية للحفاظ على الحقوق موضوع النزاع ...
attacks.change: New statements b58 (536 مكرر 6 ¶1) and b59 (¶2); new territory rule t5 (debt_written_fixed_due yes and a specialised matter: check whether the order to pay goes to the specialised court's president); x7 cites b58 in its basis, message and interpretiveNote (the reading of «كل الصلاحيات»); n5 cites b59; k23, k49, k55 refs. Example v-adv6.

attacks.claim: x1 warns 'administrative court' whenever a public body is a party. Law 08-08 on social security disputes keeps the general disputes between a social security body and an insured person or employer before the ordinary court of the code of civil procedure (art. 15), after a compulsory prior recourse before the recourse commissions (art. 4), and sends to the administrative courts only the disputes between public institutions and administrations as employers and the social security bodies (art. 16). This is one of the disputes 'given to other courts' that cpca 800 ¶1 reserves. A lawyer suing CNAS or CASNOS who answers public_body_party = yes is pointed to the wrong order and is not told of the prior recourse.
attacks.verifierQuote: المادة 4 : ترفع الخلافات المتعلقة بالمنازعات العامة إجباريا أمام لجان الطعن المسبق، قبل أي طعن أمام الجهات القضائية. / المادة 15 : تكون القرارات الصادرة عن اللجنة الوطنية المؤهلة للطعن المسبق قابلة للطعن فيها أمام المحكمة المختصة طبقا لأحكام قانون الإجراءات المدنية. / المادة 16 : تختص الجهات القضائية الإدارية بالبت في الخلافات التي تنشأ بين المؤسسات والإدارات العمومية بصفتها هيئات مستخدمة وبين هيئات الضمان الاجتماعي.
attacks.quoteRef: Law 08-08 on social security disputes, Official Journal 2008 no. 11 (2 March 2008), file sha256 7e4cb5a458edff28d7c55cca333440589a241e7fc11044690aa93c9da105d415, art. 4 p. 8, arts. 15 and 16 p. 9
attacks.change: x1's message names the exception of cpca 800 ¶1 and, among special texts, general social security disputes after the prior recourse; x1 made interpretive (the slots cannot tell these disputes apart, so it still warns); open point o12 (grade D, both readings); k28 updated; request appended. Later amendments of law 08-08 were not searched. Example v-adv7.

attacks.claim: Customs Code art. 273 (law 79-07, as amended, in particular by law 17-04) is said to give the courts that hear civil cases jurisdiction over objections to the payment or refund of customs duties and similar disputes with the customs administration, although that administration is the State. If so, x1 points a lawyer suing the customs administration to the administrative court when the ordinary court is competent. Not checked on joradp.dz: I did not locate the issue and page.
attacks.verifierQuote: المادة 273 : تنظر الجهة القضائية المختصة بالبت في القضايا المدنية، في الاعتراضات المتعلقة بدفع الحقوق والرسوم أو استردادها ومعارضات الإكراه وغيرها من القضايا الجمركية الأخرى التي لا تدخل في اختصاص القضاء الجزائي.
attacks.quoteRef: Customs Code art. 273 as amended, Official Journal 1998 no. 61 (23 August 1998), p. 52, file sha256 ca8759008c19fa8fdc333c49542e270ed30e6955716db235071aab17ac86f5b7; law 17-04 (Official Journal 2017 no. 11, art. 115, p. 38, sha256 240eb021fa8da4f8d4f99b6c92e5bc9ff636c70ee8e1b7ef88fc0758cf64b8f1) amends arts. 271, 276, 277, 279, not 273; other amendments not searched
attacks.change: x1's message names civil customs disputes among the special-text exceptions; open point o13 (grade D, both readings); k28 updated; request appended. Example v-adv8.

attacks.claim: For tax disputes, which x1 and t1 send to the administrative court of the place of the tax (cpca 804 ¶2), the Code of Tax Procedures is said to require a prior complaint (شكوى مسبقة) to the tax administration within set periods before any court action, on pain of inadmissibility, with the court period running from the administration's decision. The record names no prior step and no special period for this case, and d1 would apply the four months of art. 829 instead. Not checked on joradp.dz.
attacks.verifierQuote: 1– في مادة الضرائب أو الرسوم، أمام المحكمة التي يقع في دائرة اختصاصها مكان فرض الضريبة أو الرسم،
attacks.quoteRef: cpca 804 ¶2 (store); the Code of Tax Procedures is not in the store
attacks.change: Searched: the store (no tax procedure code; only cpca 804 ¶2 and civil-code 311); fetched Official Journal 2001 no. 79 (finance law for 2002, sha256 01ffbb99f60a3c84ded7080f997f038fd3abb2705604c25b948bd6d8b3045f7a) but the current wording of the prior-complaint articles depends on later finance laws and was not established. Boundary note n8 (check the tax text and any prior complaint) and open point o14 (grade D, both readings, protective: note and never block); k28 note.

attacks.claim: x6 sends the case to a criminal court ('goesTo: criminalCourt') whenever criminal_case_on_same_facts is yes. Its two texts say only that the civil judge is bound by the facts a criminal judgment necessarily decided, and where a damages claim is brought. Neither text sends a civil damages claim to the criminal court. b38, the only text on a pending criminal case, concerns a handwriting-comparison claim and is not used.
attacks.verifierQuote: المادة 4 : يجوز مباشرة الدعوى المدنية مع الدعوى العمومية في وقت واحد أمام الجهة القضائية الجزائية.
attacks.quoteRef: Law 25-14 (Code of Criminal Procedure), Official Journal 2025 no. 54 (13 August 2025), file sha256 50e9671fe8d4377c616af3f6652126796b62eee49eb67397427b775abd7deb73, art. 4, p. 8
attacks.change: None to goesTo: the criminal court is a route the Code of Criminal Procedure in force opens for the civil action, and the exit only warns. Its basis texts in the store do not say so; the message and note now name the Code (change recorded under adv-4 and adv-5).

attacks.claim: t4 fires on public_body_party=yes plus cancel_decision, but the Algiers administrative court of appeal hears only decisions of central authorities, national bodies and national professional organisations. For a decision of a commune or wilaya, article 801 gives the local administrative court. The slots cannot tell the two apart, so t4 fires together with t1 and x3 on a case that is plainly local, such as a commune.
attacks.verifierQuote: وتختص المحكمة الإدارية للاستئناف للجزائر بالفصل كدرجة أولى في دعاوى إلغاء وتفسير وتقدير مشروعية القرارات الإدارية الصادرة عن السلطات الإدارية المركزية والهيئات العمومية الوطنية والمنظمات المهنية الوطنية.
attacks.quoteRef: cpca 900 مكرر ¶3 (store, version law-22-13); cpca 801 ¶2 to ¶6
attacks.change: Proposed choice slot administrative_decision_author (local / central_national); t4 now also requires central_national, so it is not shown for a commune's or wilaya's decision. Example v-atk2.

attacks.claim: d1 carries the readings from articles 831 and 832: the period cannot be set against the claimant unless the notification mentions it, and it can be interrupted or suspended. d2 is also marked interpretive and rests on b24, but it leaves these readings out. The same exceptions apply to the two-month court period after a grievance.
attacks.verifierQuote: تنقطع آجال الطعن في الحالتين الآتيتين : / وتوقف آجال الطعن في الحالتين الآتيتين : // لا يحتج بأجل الطعن المنصوص عليه في المادة 829 أعلاه، إلا إذا أشير إليه في تبليغ القرار المطعون فيه.
attacks.change: d2's basis adds b20 and b21 (832), its message names 832 and a second reading keeps interruption and suspension. 831 ¶1 is not carried over: its words name only «أجل الطعن المنصوص عليه في المادة 829»; d2's note says so. Example v-atk3.

attacks.claim: d2 starts the two months only from the slot administrative_grievance_rejection_date, which is the notified refusal under b17. Article 830 ¶3 also covers silence: the two months run from the end of the administration's two-month silence, counted from notification of the grievance. No slot or rule handles the silence case. d2 fires with grievance filed=yes but has no start date when the administration said nothing.
attacks.verifierQuote: يعد سكوت الجهة الإدارية المتظلم أمامها عن الرد، خلال شهرين (2)، بمثابة قرار بالرفض ويبدأ هذا الأجل من تاريخ تبليغ التظلم. / وفي حالة سكوت الجهة الإدارية، يستفيد المتظلم من أجل شهرين (2)، لتقديم طعنه القضائي، الذي يسري من تاريخ انتهاء أجل الشهرين (2) المشار إليه في الفقرة أعلاه.
attacks.change: New deadline d5 for silence (and a late answer): four months from the new date slot administrative_grievance_date, interpretive, warn; o10 rewritten. Example v-atk4.

attacks.claim: d1 is switched off whenever administrative_grievance_filed is yes. Article 830 ¶1 allows the grievance only within the 829 period, so a grievance filed after the four months does not save the claim. With a late grievance, no deadline rule warns of the expired four months. d1 also applies only to cancel_decision, while 829 sets the four months for the appeal before the administrative court generally.
attacks.verifierQuote: يجوز للشخص المعني بالقرار الإداري، تقديم تظلم إلى الجهة الإدارية مصدرة القرار في الأجل المنصوص عليه في المادة 829 أعلاه. // يسري من تاريخ التبليغ الشخصي بنسخة من القرار الإداري الفردي، أو من تاريخ نشر القرار الإداري الجماعي أو التنظيمي.
attacks.change: d1 is switched off only when a grievance was lodged within the period (new slot administrative_grievance_in_time); d2 and d5 require it too; d1's message says a late grievance opens no new period and its basis adds b15. The second half is not followed: 829 runs from the notification or publication of an administrative decision, which d1 already requires. Example v-atk5.

attacks.claim: b37 drops the end of article 39 ¶3: claims for damage caused by the act of the administration are also brought before the court of the place of the harmful act. This matters for the public-body exits (x1, b5, b12).
attacks.verifierQuote: 2 - في مواد تعويض الضرر عن جناية، أو جنحة، أو مخالفة، أو فعل تقصيري، ودعاوى الأضرار الحاصلة بفعل الإدارة، أمام الجهة القضائية التي وقع في دائرة اختصاصها الفعل الضار،
attacks.change: b37's says now includes claims for damage caused by the act of the administration. No rule changes: the paragraph fixes the place, not the order of courts. Example v-atk6.

attacks.claim: x1 warns of the administrative court for every case with public_body_party=yes, except damages caused by a public vehicle. But article 800 ¶1 itself excepts disputes given to other courts, and the slot public_body_party names only the State, wilaya, commune or public administrative body. It leaves out the national public bodies and national professional organisations of 800 ¶2. x1 also sends all of these cases to the 'administrativeCourt' without separating the Algiers court of appeal under 900 مكرر.
attacks.verifierQuote: المحاكم الإدارية هي جهات الولاية العامة في المنازعات الإدارية، باستثناء المنازعات الموكلة إلى جهات قضائية أخرى.
attacks.change: x1's message now states the exception for disputes given to other courts and names the special texts found (adv-7, adv-8); x1 interpretive. The national bodies of 800 ¶2 were already named in the message (o6); the administrative court of appeal of Algiers (900 مكرر ¶3) is an administrative court, so goesTo stays. Example v-atk7.

attacks.claim: b34 says the repealed paragraphs concern 'the specialised poles of the courts'. The quoted text lists only article numbers (32 ¶7 to ¶10, 826, 835, 836, 912 to 914) and says nothing about specialised poles. The characterisation has no support in the cited words.
attacks.verifierQuote: تختص الأقطاب المتخصصة المنعقدة في بعض المحاكم بالنظر دون سواها في المنازعات المتعلقة بالتجارة الدولية، والإفلاس والتسوية القضائية، والمنازعات المتعلقة بالبنوك، ومنازعات الملكية الفكرية، والمنازعات البحرية والنقل الجوي، ومنازعات التأمينات.
attacks.quoteRef: cpca 32 ¶7 (store, older wording law-08-09, repealed by law-22-13 14 ¶2)
attacks.change: None: the paragraphs 7 to 10 of article 32 that law 22-13 repealed are the paragraphs on the specialised poles.

attacks.claim: b35 says the tribunal decides every kind of case. It leaves out article 32 ¶5: where sections have not been created, the civil section hears everything except social cases. In those courts a commercial dispute has no commercial section.
attacks.verifierQuote: غير أنه في المحاكم التي لم تنشأ فيها الأقسام، يبقى القسم المدني هو الذي ينظر في جميع النزاعات باستثناء القضايا الاجتماعية.
attacks.change: None: the paragraph distributes cases among the sections of the same tribunal (module court-sections); no case leaves the ordinary court. Already answered by checklist k65 (doesNotApply).

attacks.claim: b30 makes the record of non-conciliation a condition on pain of inadmissibility. The slots nonconciliation_record and nonconciliation_record_delivered_on exist. But x4 only warns, and neither it nor any other rule checks them. The warning treats the conciliation step as something to 'check', while a missing record is a defect that bars the claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: في حالة فشل محاولة الصلح، ترفع الدعوى أمام المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة بعريضة افتتاح الدعوى طبقا للقواعد المنصوص عليها في هذا القانون مرفقة، تحت طائلة عدم قبول الدعوى شكلا، بمحضر عدم الصلح.
attacks.change: None: x4's message states the step and its sanction in the text's terms («تحت طائلة عدم القبول»), and an exit may only warn. The step's own rule is assigned to the module conciliation-mediation (k13, k41), which this verifier was not allowed to open; whether that module carries it must be checked there.

attacks.claim: x5 fires on employer_in_bankruptcy_or_settlement=yes alone and sends the case to the specialised commercial court. The texts do not say that a worker's wage claim against a bankrupt employer is a 'judicial settlement and bankruptcy dispute'. Article 32 ¶3 names social cases among those the tribunal hears, and no rule separates the worker's claim from the collective procedure.
attacks.verifierQuote: – التسوية القضائية والإفلاس،
attacks.change: The text names judicial settlement and bankruptcy without saying whether a worker's claim against a bankrupt employer is such a dispute; the Commercial Code's bankruptcy articles are not in the store. x5 stays interpretive and warns only; open point o2 (grade D) keeps both readings.

attacks.claim: x7 fires on requests=payment and debt_written_fixed_due=yes. It ignores defendant_resides_abroad, which exists as a slot and bears on the domicile 'in Algeria' that article 306 requires for the debtor. It also ignores the requirement that the debt be a sum of money, so a written, fixed and due claim for something other than money would still trigger it.
attacks.verifierQuote: يجوز للدائن بدين من النقود، مستحق وحال الأداء ومعين المقدار وثابت بالكتابة / 2 - اسم ولقب المدين وموطنه الحقيقي أو المختار في الجزائر،
attacks.change: None: the slot debt_written_fixed_due asks whether the debt is «مبلغ من النقود», so a non-money claim does not trigger x7; the text requires a domicile, real or chosen, in Algeria, not residence, so defendant_resides_abroad cannot close the route; x7 asks the lawyer to check the domicile (open point o5).

attacks.claim: x2 sends the case to the administrative court on worker_is_public_servant=yes alone. The only text on place is article 804 ¶5, which is a territorial exception to 803. The slot also reaches contract agents, while b25 and labour-relations 3 only say such staff fall under special provisions. The rule shows no cited text that gives the administrative court subject-matter jurisdiction, and its basis includes b9, which is only about public order.
attacks.verifierQuote: 4– في مادة المنازعات المتعلقة بالموظفين أو أعوان الدولة أو غيرهم من الأشخاص العاملين في المؤسسات العمومية الإدارية، أمام المحكمة التي يقع في دائرة اختصاصها مكان ممارسة وظيفتهم،
attacks.change: 804 sits among the territorial rules yet says which actions «ترفع ... وجوبا أمام المحاكم الإدارية»: the texts allow both readings. x2 stays interpretive and warns only; open point o8 keeps both readings.

attacks.claim: From memory: law 22-13 of 12 July 2022 amended the CPCA, and the list of matters for the specialised commercial court and the conciliation article 536 مكرر 4 (period, appointment) may have been amended again or fixed by implementing texts and installation orders. Check the current wording of articles 536 مكرر to 536 مكرر 5 and any decree or order fixing the installed courts and their areas.
attacks.verifierQuote: يحدد عدد المحاكم التجارية المتخصصة بخمس وعشرين (25) محكمة عبر كامل التراب الوطني، تحدد دوائر اختصاصها الإقليمي طبقا للملحق المرفق بهذا المرسوم.
attacks.quoteRef: Executive decree 26-133, Official Journal 2026 no. 27 (12 April 2026), p. 10, file sha256 099f3ad407e7b85a7546b1d29f0e274c45df08d253076c80965c3f68abaf0c0c; original Executive decree 23-53, Official Journal 2023 no. 2 (15 January 2023), p. 19, file sha256 6747daf0e1dcfd886661272c3c4bdf9a2a11575e36ee2b683e8769a111ce3137 (12 courts, art. 2)
attacks.change: The implementing decrees exist (23-53, amended by 26-133): changes recorded under adv-2 and adv-3 (x4, t2, k14, k42, o11). The wording of cpca 536 مكرر to 536 مكرر 5 is unchanged since law 22-13 according to the amendment ledger (scan to 2026-11-10). Example v-atk14.

attacks.claim: From memory: law 90-04 of 1990 on the settlement of individual labour disputes (conciliation office, then the social section) and the general civil service statute (ordinance 06-03) govern the jurisdiction and prior steps for wage and labour claims. Check whether they change the jurisdiction of the administrative or social section for public-sector workers.
attacks.verifierQuote: يعد نزاعا فرديا في العمل بحكم هذا القانون، كل خلاف في العمل قائم بين عامل أجير ومستخدم بشأن تنفيذ علاقة العمل
attacks.change: Searched the store: law 90-04 (labour-disputes 1, 2) covers disputes of «عامل أجير», whom labour-relations 3 ¶1 puts apart from civil servants; ordinance 06-03 on the civil service is not in the store and was not fetched. No text found that settles the jurisdiction; x2 stays interpretive and warns, open point o8.

attacks.claim: When the petition asks for cancel decision and (public body party is yes or claim challenges administrative decision is yes), the case leaves the ordinary courts (administrativeCourt). | no: Central and national decisions are assigned to another court: «وتختص المحكمة الإدارية للاستئناف للجزائر بالفصل كدرجة أولى». Article 801 names specific issuing bodies; it does not establish the blanket public-party-or-administrative-decision rule.
attacks.verifierQuote: وتختص المحكمة الإدارية للاستئناف للجزائر بالفصل كدرجة أولى في دعاوى إلغاء وتفسير وتقدير مشروعية القرارات الإدارية الصادرة عن السلطات الإدارية المركزية
attacks.change: None: local decisions go to the administrative courts (801) and central ones to the administrative court of appeal of Algiers (900 مكرر ¶3), both administrative courts; x3 is interpretive (o9), warns only, and its message names both.

attacks.claim: When specialised commercial matter is one of intellectual_property, commercial_company, bankruptcy_settlement, bank_with_merchant, maritime_air_insurance, international_trade and not (specialised commercial courts installed is no), the case leaves the ordinary courts (specialisedCommercialCourt). | no: The automatic routing omits cases retained by the existing jurisdictions: «وتبقى الجهات القضائية الإدارية والأقسام التجارية مختصة بالفصل في الدعاوى المرفوعة أمامها قبل تاريخ تنصيب الجهات القضائية الجديدة».
attacks.verifierQuote: وتبقى الجهات القضائية الإدارية والأقسام التجارية مختصة بالفصل في الدعاوى المرفوعة أمامها قبل تاريخ تنصيب الجهات القضائية الجديدة.
attacks.change: None for this point: the paragraph keeps cases already filed before installation; the petition being drafted is not yet filed. x4 was changed for another reason (adv-2).

attacks.claim: Civil servants, contract agents of public bodies and administrations, and staff of public administrative bodies are governed by special provisions, not by the labour relations law. | partly: The TEXT subjects these personnel to special legislative and regulatory provisions, but does not expressly exclude application of the labour relations law.
attacks.verifierQuote: يخضع المستخدمون المدنيون والعسكريون التابعون للدفاع الوطني والقضاة والموظفون والأعوان المتعاقدون في الهيئات والإدارات العمومية في الدولة والولايات والبلديات ومستخدمو المؤسسات العمومية ذات الطابع الإداري، لأحكام تشريعية وتنظيمية خاصة.
attacks.change: b25's says now reads «لأحكام تشريعية وتنظيمية خاصة» without adding that the labour relations law does not apply. Example v-sup6.

attacks.claim: Urgent matters, judicial sequestration and protective measures are brought by petition before the competent court. | partly: For protective measures, the TEXT specifies those not governed by special procedures: «غير منظم بإجراءات خاصة». It does not establish the stated procedure for every protective measure.
attacks.verifierQuote: أو إذا اقتضى الأمر الفصل في إجراء يتعلق بالحراسة القضائية أو بأي تدبير تحفظي غير منظم بإجراءات خاصة
attacks.change: b50's says now limits protective measures to those not governed by special procedures. Example v-sup15.

attacks.claim: When employer in bankruptcy or settlement is yes, the case leaves the ordinary courts (specialisedCommercialCourt). | partly: The TEXT assigns judicial-settlement and bankruptcy disputes to the specialised commercial court, not every case involving an employer in bankruptcy or settlement. It also makes the jurisdiction rules effective only from installation of the new courts.
attacks.verifierQuote: – التسوية القضائية والإفلاس،
attacks.change: As atk-11: x5 stays interpretive and warns; o2 grade D. On installation, decree 26-133 art. 2 مكرر 1 extends installed courts over new areas (o11).

attacks.claim: If no objection is made in time, the order acquires the force of res judicata and the enforcement formula is granted. | partly: Granting the enforcement formula additionally requires presentation of a certificate of non-objection: «بعد تقديم شهادة عدم الاعتراض». The statement omits this condition.
attacks.verifierQuote: يقوم رئيس أمناء الضبط بمنح الصيغة التنفيذية لطالب التنفيذ بعد تقديم شهادة عدم الاعتراض.
attacks.change: b48's says now names the certificate of non-objection. Example v-sup18.

attacks.claim: The administrative courts hear actions to annul, interpret or review the legality of decisions of the wilaya, the decentralised State services, the commune, regional professional organisations and local public administrative bodies. | partly: The State services named by the TEXT are specifically those at wilaya level: «على مستوى الولاية». It does not establish the same jurisdiction for State services at other levels.
attacks.verifierQuote: – الولاية والمصالح غير الممركزة للدولة على مستوى الولاية،
attacks.change: b3's says now reads «على مستوى الولاية». Example v-sup19.

attacks.claim: When the petition asks for payment and debt written fixed due is yes, the case leaves the ordinary courts (paymentOrder). | no: The procedure is optional: «يجوز للدائن». The right to file a claim remains: «دون المساس بحق الدائن في رفع دعوى وفقا للقواعد المقررة لها». There is no mandatory departure from the ordinary courts.
attacks.verifierQuote: يجوز للدائن بدين من النقود ... / الأمر بالرفض غير قابل لأي طعن، دون المساس بحق الدائن في رفع دعوى وفقا للقواعد المقررة لها.
attacks.change: None: x7 only warns, and its message says the creditor «يجوز» ask for the order and keeps the claim (k25).

attacks.claim: The time limit is 2 months, running from the date of administrative grievance rejection date; it is a forfeiture period, counted by the method excludeFirstAndLastDay; it applies when the petition asks for cancel decision and (public body party is yes or claim challenges administrative decision is yes) and administrative grievance filed is yes. | no: For a timely express refusal, the starting event is «من تاريخ تبليغ الرفض», not the date the refusal was made. For silence, it is «من تاريخ انتهاء أجل الشهرين (2)». The stated cancellation/public-party applicability test is also not supplied.
attacks.verifierQuote: في حالة رد الجهة الإدارية خلال الأجل الممنوح لها، يبدأ سريان أجل شهرين (2) من تاريخ تبليغ الرفض. / الذي يسري من تاريخ انتهاء أجل الشهرين (2)
attacks.change: As adv-1: the slot already held the date the refusal was notified; d2 now runs only for a refusal notified in time, and silence is counted by d5 from the end of the two months. Example v-sup35.

attacks.claim: The tribunal is the court of general jurisdiction and decides all cases, in particular civil, commercial, maritime, social, real-property and family cases. | partly: The TEXT limits the cases to those within the tribunal's territorial jurisdiction: «والتي تختص بها إقليميا». The statement omits this qualification.
attacks.verifierQuote: تفصل المحكمة في جميع القضايا، لاسيما المدنية والتجارية والبحرية والاجتماعية والعقارية وقضايا شؤون الأسرة والتي تختص بها إقليميا.
attacks.change: b35's says now adds «التي تختص بها إقليميا». Example v-sup41.

attacks.claim: The time limit is 4 months, running from the date of administrative decision notice date; it is a forfeiture period, counted by the method excludeFirstAndLastDay; it applies when the petition asks for cancel decision and (public body party is yes or claim challenges administrative decision is yes) and not (administrative grievance filed is yes). | no: The starting event depends on the decision: «التبليغ الشخصي بنسخة من القرار الإداري الفردي» or «نشر القرار الإداري الجماعي أو التنظيمي», rather than one general notice date. Opposability also requires mention of the period in the notification. The stated public-party/no-grievance applicability test is not supplied.
attacks.verifierQuote: يسري من تاريخ التبليغ الشخصي بنسخة من القرار الإداري الفردي، أو من تاريخ نشر القرار الإداري الجماعي أو التنظيمي.
attacks.change: None on the starting event: the slot's question asks for either date, as the text names them; opposability under 831 is kept as d1's second reading (o4). d1's grievance gate was refined under adv-1.

attacks.claim: A grievance may be lodged with the authority that made the decision within the period of the court action. | partly: The TEXT permits a grievance within the period referred to in Article 829, but that article's contents are absent; this excerpt does not identify it as the court-action period.
attacks.verifierQuote: يحدد أجل الطعن أمام المحكمة الإدارية بأربعة (4) أشهر
attacks.change: None: the period 830 ¶1 points to is the period of the action before the administrative court.

attacks.claim: The time limit is 1 year, running from the date of payment order date; it is a procedural period, counted by the method excludeFirstAndLastDay; it applies when the petition asks for payment and payment order issued is yes. | partly: The year concerns requesting the enforcement formula. The TEXT does not expressly classify it as a procedural period. Article 405 excludes notification/service days and the ending day, but does not expressly exclude the issuance day from this issuance-based period.
attacks.verifierQuote: تحسب كل الآجال المنصوص عليها في هذا القانون كاملة، ولا يحسب يوم التبليغ أو التبليغ الرسمي ويوم انقضاء الأجل. // كل أمر أداء لم يطلب إمهاره بالصيغة التنفيذية خلال سنة واحدة (1) من تاريخ صدوره، يسقط ولا يرتب أي أثر.
attacks.change: 405 names the day of notification, not the day an order is made: both countings are open. d3 keeps both readings, takes the earlier last day as the rule (counting excludeFirstDay instead of excludeFirstAndLastDay), and open point o15 (grade C) is added. The kind procedural is the record's label; the text says only «يسقط ولا يرتب أي أثر», quoted in extract.

attacks.claim: When worker is public servant is yes, the case leaves the ordinary courts (administrativeCourt). | partly: The TEXT requires administrative courts for the listed public-service disputes. It does not say that a worker's public-servant status alone transfers every case regardless of its subject or another court's assigned jurisdiction.
attacks.verifierQuote: 4– في مادة المنازعات المتعلقة بالموظفين أو أعوان الدولة أو غيرهم من الأشخاص العاملين في المؤسسات العمومية الإدارية
attacks.change: As atk-13: x2 interpretive, warns, o8.

attacks.claim: The paragraphs of the code on the specialised poles of the courts, and other articles of the code, were repealed. | partly: The TEXT repeals paragraphs 7–10 of Article 32 and the listed other articles, but does not identify the repealed paragraphs as provisions on specialised judicial poles.
attacks.verifierQuote: تختص الأقطاب المتخصصة المنعقدة في بعض المحاكم بالنظر دون سواها ...
attacks.change: None: as atk-8.

attacks.claim: When criminal case on same facts is yes or (obligation is tort compensation is yes and damage caused by offence is yes), the case leaves the ordinary courts (criminalCourt). | no: The TEXT concerns the limited binding effect of a criminal judgment on the civil judge and territorial venue for damages: «أمام الجهة القضائية التي وقع في دائرة اختصاصها الفعل الضار». It does not transfer such cases to a criminal court.
attacks.verifierQuote: المادة 4 : يجوز مباشرة الدعوى المدنية مع الدعوى العمومية في وقت واحد أمام الجهة القضائية الجزائية.
attacks.quoteRef: Law 25-14 (Code of Criminal Procedure), Official Journal 2025 no. 54 (13 August 2025), file sha256 50e9671fe8d4377c616af3f6652126796b62eee49eb67397427b775abd7deb73, art. 4, p. 8
attacks.change: None to the exit: as atk-1; the message now names the Code of Criminal Procedure (adv-5).

attacks.claim: When public body party is yes and not (the petition asks for damages and public vehicle damage is yes), the case leaves the ordinary courts (administrativeCourt). | no: The TEXT expressly provides another ordinary-court exception: «يكون من اختصاص المحاكم العادية المنازعات الآتية» and «1 - مخالفات الطرق». Excluding public-vehicle damage alone therefore does not establish the stated rule.
attacks.verifierQuote: خلافا لأحكام المادتين 800 و801 أعلاه، يكون من اختصاص المحاكم العادية المنازعات الآتية : / 1 - مخالفات الطرق.
attacks.change: None: x1 only warns and its message names road offences as kept by the ordinary courts (b6 in its basis), so the lawyer checks it.

attacks.claim: The commercial section hears commercial disputes except those given to the specialised commercial court. | partly: The TEXT excepts disputes mentioned in Article 536 bis, but this excerpt does not identify those disputes as assigned to the specialised commercial court.
attacks.verifierQuote: تختص المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة بالنظر في المنازعات المذكورة أدناه :
attacks.change: None: the disputes 531 ¶1 excepts are those 536 مكرر ¶1 gives to the specialised commercial court.

attacks.claim: The time limit is 15 days, running from the date of payment order notified on; it is a procedural period, counted by the method excludeFirstAndLastDay; it applies when the petition asks for payment and payment order issued is yes. | partly: The TEXT does not expressly classify the period as procedural. It specifies formal service («التبليغ الرسمي») as the objection-period trigger and distinguishes the fifteen-day payment demand from the fifteen-day objection period.
attacks.verifierQuote: بأن للمدين حق الاعتراض على أمر الأداء في أجل خمسة عشر (15) يوما تبدأ من تاريخ التبليغ الرسمي.
attacks.change: None: d4's extract and start are the objection period of 308 ¶3 from formal service, distinct from the payment demand of 308 ¶2; 'procedural' is the record's label.

attacks.claim: The territorial jurisdiction of the administrative courts follows the general rules on the defendant's domicile. | partly: The TEXT refers to Articles 37 and 38 without giving their contents; it does not itself say that territorial jurisdiction follows the defendant's domicile.
attacks.verifierQuote: يؤول الاختصاص الإقليمي للجهة القضائية التي يقع في دائرة اختصاصها موطن المدعى عليه
attacks.change: None.

attacks.claim: Blind boundary case bc9 (Dissolution (of a commercial company) asked, no public body; petition 2026-07-12; slots {"public_body_party": "no", "requests": ["dissolution"]}) expects «leavesOrdinaryCourt» about [cpca 536 مكرر ¶3], because: 536 مكرر ¶3: «منازعات الشركات التجارية، لا سيما منازعات الشركاء وحل وتصفية الشركات».
